name: 08230 · Ocean View, NJ
findings: ZIP 08230 (Ocean View) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 6 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08230 (Ocean View) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 08230 (Ocean View) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 25% of the typical level).
